column1: # "???", the Jupiter commander above Heart: Vale's last optional super boss.

column3: You knew Heart would\ncome after me.{end_wait}
She acts on old wounds.\nI didn't give her those.{end_wait}
Then why did you let\nher fight me?{end_wait}
I wanted to see what\nyou would do.{end_wait}
She could have died.{end_wait}
And yet she lives.\nYou held your ground\nwithout hating her.{end_wait}
You know I'm not\nMatthew.{end_wait}
Of course. He hasn't\nbeen born yet.{end_wait}
Then how do you know\nwhat he'll look like?{end_wait}
There are people here\nwho never belonged\nin your journey.{end_wait}
They didn't arrive\nby accident.{end_wait}

I know who made
that possible.{page_break}But I'm more interested
in how you've kept
surviving them.{end_wait}
Then tell me\nwhat's happening.{end_wait}
Not yet.\nDraw your sword.{end_wait}
Now tell me why\nyou're here.{end_wait}
I came to measure\nyou. I was wrong about\nhow far you'd come.{end_wait}
You fought better\nthan I expected.{page_break}That changes things.{end_wait}
What things?{end_wait}
Plans I won't share\nwith you. Not yet.{end_wait}

Heart is one of my
commanders. Her anger
is her own.{page_break}I won't let it ruin
what comes next.{end_wait}
And the others?\nAre they yours too?{end_wait}
Not everyone needs\norders to go where\nI want them.{end_wait}
When the Grave Eclipse\ncomes, remember\nthis day.{end_wait}
When that day comes,\nI'll remember you, Isaac.{end_wait}
